decisions.reason: As a surviving 2023 line extension with its own 2024 page, it looks like a low-cost option on a proven drainage platform, so we would keep it unless demand for the black finish proves clearly weak.
Because it had dedicated presentation in both 2023 and 2024 and fits a clear application trend in seamless bathrooms, its value appears sufficiently validated to justify keeping it on the market.

This 2024 launch is still in the option-testing phase and, despite higher uncertainty and the earlier withdrawal of a related pump-assisted concept, we would keep it one more year to learn whether the niche justifies further commitment.
